about_the_game:
KINETYPE is a minimalist ASCII roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Forget the mouse and the controller. To navigate the procedurally generated terminal, you type your commands and hit enter.

Your objective is simple: enter the run, collect what you can, and reach the extraction point. Success earns you Bytes, a currency used for permanent player upgrades and items in the shop. If you fail, your current inventory and win streak are wiped, but your permanent progression remains for the next run.

THE TERMINAL ABILITIES

Survival depends on scavenged code fragments. To claim an ability, move over it and type its name to execute the command:

  • ZAP: Deletes the closest enemy instantly.

  • BOMB: Sets an explosive with a short fuse.

  • MINE: Deploys a proximity trap for trailing enemies.

  • SILENCE: Pauses all enemy movement for 20 steps.

  • PING: Visualizes a direct path to the exit.

  • DASH: Teleports the player by pressing the TAB key.

  • AND MORE: Discover a wide range of additional commands as you dive deeper into the sectors.

TERMINAL THREATS

The grid is populated by hostile entities designed to terminate your session. Every enemy reacts to your movements, creating a tactical, turn-based puzzle:

  • CHASER: A persistent hunter that tracks your coordinates across the grid.

  • VIRUS: Infects your trail of characters, draining the Bytes you’ve collected for extraction.

  • BLINDER: Corrupts your visual feed, forcing you to type and execute commands by feel for a temporary duration.

  • FUSE: Similar to a Chaser, but triggers a catastrophic explosion when it nears your trail.

COMMAND AND CONTROL

By default, Kinetype is a strategic experience where the world only moves when you type. This allows you to plan your route and manage your abilities carefully. For those who want to test their typing speed, Hardcore Mode removes the safety net, forcing enemies to move on a timer if you aren't fast enough with your keystrokes.

CUSTOMIZE THE GRID

Kinetype is built to be flexible. You can play with a clean monochrome look, a classic green "Matrix" terminal, or mod in your own custom colour themes.

Whether you are aiming for a record-breaking win streak or just grinding Bytes for your next upgrade, the terminal is yours to command.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (Dual-core, 3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / AMD Radeon R7
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (Quad-core or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
